version_Y.quote: August 14 – Update to the investigation: The generic 35-amp fuse provided by APC Manufacturing, installed to protect the macerator circuit can create a subpar connection and create heat, allowing the plastic housing to melt.
This may cause confusion and a fuse installed in the wrong location based upon the diagram key with risk of over or under protection of a circuit.
